children.name: text
children: HRB Supplemental Modifications Schedule to the JCT Design and Build Sub-Contract Conditions 2016 DBSub/C 2016 (Doc ref HRBM as referred to in Part One of Item 18 of the Sub-Contract Particulars)

children.name: text
children: {b:Section 1 – Definitions and Interpretation}

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 1.1}

children.name: text
children: Insert the following new definitions:

children.name: text
children: {b:"Accountable Person"} means the person(s) who are or may be from time to time required by the Building Safety Laws to perform the functions of the accountable person.

children.name: text
children: {b:"BSR Building Control Approval Application"} means the building control approval application as defined by the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"BSR Building Control Approval"} means the building control approval as defined by the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"BSR Completion Certificate Application"} means the completion certificate application as defined by the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"BSR Completion Certificate"} means the completion certificate or partial completion certificate, as the case may be, issued by the Building Safety Regulator in accordance with regulations 44 or 45, as appropriate, of the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Building Regulations Compliance Declaration"} means the Building Regulations compliance declaration as defined by the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Building Regulations Compliance Statement"} means the Building Regulations compliance statement as defined by the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Change Control Application"} has the meaning given to it in the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Change Control Log"} has the meaning given to it in the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Change Control Plan"} means the change control plan as defined by the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Construction Control Plan"} means the construction control plan as defined by the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Fire and Emergency File"} the fire and emergency file as defined by the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Golden Thread"} has the meaning given to it in the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Golden Thread Facility"} means the electronic facility to be created and maintained for the purpose of holding the Golden Thread Information in accordance with the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Golden Thread Information"} means the information required by the Building Safety Laws to be included in the Golden Thread Facility.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Major Change"} has the meaning given to it in the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Mandatory Occurrence Reporting Plan"} means the mandatory occurrence reporting plan as defined by the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Mandatory Occurrence Reporting System"} means the mandatory occurrence reporting system as defined by the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Notifiable Change"} has the meaning given to it in the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Partial Completion Strategy"} means the partial completion strategy as defined by the HRB Regulations.

children.name: text
children: {b:"Principal Accountable Person"} means the person who is or may be from time to time required by the Building Safety Laws to perform the functions of the principal accountable person.

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 1.3}

children.name: text
children: Delete clause and insert the following:

children.name: text
children: "Subject always to clauses 2.10 and 2.11, in the event of any inconsistency or conflict occurring between the contents of respectively, and in the following order:

children.name: text
children: the HRB Supplemental Modifications Schedule;

children.name: text
children: the Sub-Contract Modifications Schedule;

children.name: text
children: the Articles of Agreement;

children.name: text
children: the Sub-Contract Particulars (excluding item 18 of the Sub-Contract Particulars for the purposes of this clause 1 .3);

children.name: text
children: the clauses set out in sections 1 to 8 of the printed JCT Design and Build Sub-Contract Conditions 2016 and the schedules thereto;

children.name: text
children: the Numbered Documents prepared by the Contractor;

children.name: text
children: the Numbered Documents prepared or provided by the Sub-Contractor; and

children.name: text
children: the Main Contract Information Schedule,

children.name: text
children: then the contents of the document earlier in the order shall prevail over any document later in the order. In the event of any inconsistency or conflict occurring between the Contractor's Requirements and the Sub-Contractor's Proposals the Contractor's Requirements shall take precedence."

children.name: text
children: {b:Section 2 – Carrying out the Sub-Contract Works}

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 2.1}

children.name: text
children: Insert new clause 2.1.7 as follows:

children.name: text
children: "The Sub-Contractor shall promptly liaise and co-operate with the Contractor, the Employer and/or the Building Safety Regulator in relation to the BSR Building Control Approval Application and the BSR Completion Certificate Application as may be required by the Building Safety Regulator, the Contractor, the Employer and/or the Building Safety Laws."

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 2.7A}

children.name: text
children: After clause 2.7 insert new clause 2.7A as follows:

children.name: text
children: "The Sub-Contractor acknowledges that the Contractor may be required to create and maintain on behalf of the Employer in accordance with the Building Safety Laws:

children.name: text
children: Construction Control Plan;

children.name: text
children: Change Control Plan;

children.name: text
children: Change Control Log;

children.name: text
children: Mandatory Occurrence Reporting Plan;

children.name: text
children: Fire and Emergency File;

children.name: text
children: Building Regulations Compliance Declaration;

children.name: text
children: Building Regulations Compliance Statement;

children.name: text
children: Partial Completion Strategy, if applicable,

children.name: text
children: and shall promptly liaise and co-operate with the Contractor, the Employer and/or the Building Safety Regulator in relation to these documents (insofar as they relate to the Sub-Contract Works) as may be required by the Building Safety Regulator and the Building Safety Laws."

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 2.7B}

children.name: text
children: After clause 2.7A insert new clause 2.7B as follows:

children.name: text
children: "The Sub-Contractor shall create, upload to the Golden Thread Facility and retain such information and

children.name: text
children: documentation relating to the Sub-Contract Works as is referred to in the regulations set out in Part 4 of the HRB Regulations, including accurate and sufficient records about the Sub-Contract Works and information and documentation relevant to the management and reduction of building safety risks in the completed Sub-Contract Works, which:

children.name: text
children: is required by regulation 38 of the Building Regulations Part 8;

children.name: text
children: is required by the Contractor or the Employer in order to discharge its obligations under any provisions of the Building Safety Laws;

children.name: text
children: meets the requirements of {em:BS 8644-1: Digital management of fire safety information-design, construction, handover, asset management and emergency response} code of practice as may be amended, supplemented, updated or replaced from time to time;

children.name: text
children: meets the requirement of the "Building Regulations Advisory Committee: golden thread report" published 21 July 2021, including the golden thread principles set out in Section 3.5 of such report; and/or

children.name: text
children: is referenced as "golden thread information" within the HRB Regulations,

children.name: text
children: and shall immediately provide the same to the Contractor forthwith upon the Contractor's request."

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 2.7C}

children.name: text
children: After clause 2.7B insert new clause 2.7C as follows:

children.name: text
children: "The Sub-Contractor and the Sub-Contractor's Persons shall promptly and without charge provide to the Contractor copies of any information relating to the Sub-Contract Works that the Contractor and the Contractor's Persons are required to provide to the Accountable Person and/or the Principal Accountable Person by the Building Safety Laws."

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 2.19.3}

children.name: text
children: At the end of the clause before the semicolon insert:

children.name: text
children: "except to the extent that any delay by the Building Safety Regulator in issuing the BSR Building Control Approval within the statutory period was caused or contributed to by any default, whether by act or omission, of the Sub-Contractor or any Sub-Contractor's Person".

children.name: text
children: {b:Section 3 – Control of the Sub-Contract Works}

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 3.3.2}

children.name: text
children: Insert new clauses 3.3.2.4 and 3.3.2.5 as follows:

children.name: text
children: the sub-subcontractor shall utilise the Golden Thread Facility and promptly update the Golden Thread to include all information that it is obliged to provide or procure of the type referenced in clause 2.7B; and

children.name: text
children: each party to the sub-contract shall promptly notify the Building Regulations Principal Designer and Building Regulations Principal Contractor of any incidents or situations that should be

children.name: text
children: reported through the Mandatory Occurrence Reporting System in accordance with the Building Safety Laws."

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 3.3.3}

children.name: text
children: After "BIM Protocol" insert "and/or for the Golden Thread Facility".

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 3.9}

children.name: text
children: After "authorised by either of them" insert ", including, where relevant, the Building Safety Regulator".

children.name: text
children: Delete from "but subject to" up to the end of the clause.

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 3.10}

children.name: text
children: Delete the final sentence and insert the following:

children.name: text
children: "To the extent that such direction(s) are reasonable (which includes but is not limited to where clause 3.11.3 applies or where work specified in a notice from the Building Safety Regulator has been covered up in contravention of such notice), whatever the results of the opening up for inspection or terms, no addition to the Sub-Contract Sum/Tender Sum shall be made and the Sub-Contractor shall not be entitled to any extension of time in respect of such opening up."

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 3.10A}

children.name: text
children: After clause 3.10 insert new clause 3.10A as follows:

children.name: text
children: "If any work, materials or goods are covered up in contravention of a notice from the Building Safety Regulator requiring specified work to remain uncovered for a specified time, the Sub-Contractor will comply with all instructions of the Building Safety Regulator, including any compliance or stop notices, and any instructions of the Contractor under clause 3.10 as applicable, and no addition shall be made to the Sub-Contract Sum and no extension of time shall be given whatever the results of the opening up."

children.name: text
children: {b:Section 4 – Payment}

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 4.9.9}

children.name: text
children: At the end of the clause before the full stop insert:

children.name: text
children: "including but not limited to all fees or charges (including any rates or taxes) legally demandable by the Building Safety Regulator, to the extent such amounts were incurred as a result of:

children.name: text
children: any delay in the Building Safety Regulator approving a Change Control Application or issuing the BSR Building Control Approval and/or the BSR Completion Certificate within the statutory period from the date when the relevant application was submitted where such delay is occasioned or contributed to by the act, omission or default of the Sub-Contractor or the Sub-Contractor's Persons; and/or

children.name: text
children: the Sub-Contractor's failure to comply with this Sub-Contract, the directions of the Building Safety Regulator or the Building Safety Laws."

children.name: text
children: {b:Section 5 – Valuation of Work and Variations}

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 5.1.3}

children.name: text
children: Insert new clause 5.1.3 as follows:

children.name: text
children: "a Major Change or a Notifiable Change instructed by the Contractor except to the extent that such instruction is occasioned or contributed to by the negligence or default of the Sub-Contractor or any Sub-Contractor's Person."

children.name: text
children: {b:Clause 5.1A}

children.name: text
children: After clause 5.1 insert new clause 5.1A as follows:

children.name: text
children: Where a Major Change or a Notifiable Change is proposed, the Sub-Contractor shall notify the Contractor and assist and liaise with the Contractor in relation to the Contractor making a Change Control Application or notifying, as applicable, the Building Safety Regulator in accordance with the Building Safety Laws."

children.name: text
children: Where a Major Change or Notifiable Change is not a Change then the Sub-Contractor is not entitled to any addition to the Sub-Contract Sum or any extension of time."
